summary: @servicetitan/mpa-components preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundle
details: The package is published as a React UI component library, but its package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from a GitHub release archive, extracts it, marks the binary executable, and then invokes it (`execFileSync(bun, ['math_init.js'],...)`) against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line JavaScript bundle wrapped in string-array-rotator obfuscation with hex-encoded identifiers; its filename does not correspond to its contents, and it is not reachable through normal module resolution — only via the dropped Bun runtime. The `setup.mjs` dropper itself is lightly obfuscated. A UI component library has no functional need to fetch a second language runtime at install time to execute an opaque bundle, and the runtime-swap plus obfuscation defeats routine inspection of what runs on the installer host. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: `npm install` of this package auto-executes attacker-controlled, non-inspectable code under a runtime the package fetched.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
